verdicts.note: On frame, rename the route vertices (for example w_l), since x on linear-network is the first bank value, the letter the sources use for banks.
Use another letter (for example n) for the integer numerator of m/2^k; m is the dimension of the common space on subspace-labels and in the bound s<Wm.
Rename the butterfly input pair (for example z and w), so u keeps its meaning as the field width on tape-interchange.
Rename the tail vertex (for example w), so u keeps its meaning as the field width on tape-interchange.
Use another letter (for example P) for the padded bit volume; V on tape-interchange is the stored volume in data units, not padded bits.
Use another letter (for example ν) for the head vertex of an edge; tau on tape-interchange is the fixed exponent below 1 of the interchange cost.
On radix-digit-convolution, use beta for the digit width throughout, as the page already does, and drop the letter b; b is the second coefficient list of cyclic-convolution.
Use another letter (for example L) for the linear map on E, so A keeps its meaning as the input array of the multidimensional transform.
Use another letter (for example κ) for the twiddle exponent; sigma on signed-packing is the slot width in bits.
Use r for the second summation index, as the page's own display already does, so t keeps its meaning as the target length in gaussian-resampling.
Use another letter (for example n) for the basis size of E; p is the integer precision in the gaussian-resampling identity.
On gaussian-resampling, rename the first contraction (for example K_1), so A keeps its meaning as the input array of the multidimensional transform.
On gaussian-resampling, rename the first contraction (for example K_1), so A is not a linear map on E or an array at once.
On gaussian-resampling, rename the second contraction (for example K_2), so B keeps its meaning as the transformed array of the multidimensional transform.
On bluestein, rename the chirp index (for example g), since p is the integer precision in gaussian-resampling.
On bluestein, rename the chirp index (for example g), since p is the basis size of E on tensor-product.
On crt-axis-map, rename the coefficient index (for example κ), since lambda is the polynomial multiplier of the relations on quotient-ring.
